entries.rationale: Hand-promoted from a japicmp CLASS_REMOVED finding via the proposer artefact (skill byte-diff-catalogue.md (local) section 8.1). The fork re-implements the parser/codegen via ANTLR4 per the ROADMAP mission; Xtext tool-surface classes including this RosettaJavaPackages helper are deliberately not replicated. Status=active because no current D-entry blesses Xtext-tool-surface absence as accepted; a future fork-mandate D-entry can promote this entry (and the dozens of sibling Xtext-class entries that will accumulate as the proposer is run) to status=accepted in one batch. Sentinel our_hash marks our absence (no bytes emitted); upstream_hash uses the same sentinel rather than a real bytecode hash to avoid pinning a baseline JAR fingerprint that the next japicmp baseline rebase will invalidate.

Class-rule entry per skill byte-diff-catalogue.md (local) section 4.3 (i)-(iii). Both javac and ECJ lower String + b + c + ... to either a StringBuilder.append() chain or invokedynamic StringConcatFactory depending on --release; both lowerings are valid bytecode for the same source per JVMS section 4. Equivalence class accepted under D19 (local) part 2 with M1 D41-C as the historical taxonomy anchor (~BOTH 1187/1241 body-diff finding pre-rebaseline, PR #6-#8 D11 convergence, 765/765 POJOs byte-identical when normalised). Sentinel hash pair (sha-256 of empty bytes) marks this as a class-rule rather than a per-occurrence entry; the __class_rule__: prefix on symbol is the discriminator. Future Layer-3 lookup must key on symbol prefix, not solely on hash pair.
